name: SunCET
document: Layout from the SatNOGS decoder suncet.ksy: the public APID 1 beacon (CTDB 2.0.5), a CCSDS space packet inside an AX.25 UI frame.
note: Imported from the SatNOGS decoder suncet.ksy; not checked against frames FBSAT59 received (none yet). Only packets with CCSDS APID 1 are decoded. The ksy also checks a Fletcher-32 checksum over the packet and the packet length; this decoder does not. Raw counts (*_raw) have a converted twin in engineering units; the bit-field state flags have a 0/1 twin. Fields the ksy leaves out (consumed opaquely) are skipped. The spacecraft time counts from 2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
